purpose: Diagnose the original context-v2 pilot's constant abstention using every example actually used for its 192 updates. Not training, independent validation, trading or profitability evidence.

completed_development_comparison.meaning: Already-exposed development quote-opportunity classification, not independent holdout, full-archive training, CFD fills or PnL. All metrics are reverified before freezing this diagnostic.

experiment.selection: Exactly all 192 original unique fit examples, unchanged original update order; no new subset, check-outcome search, oversampling or optimizer.
experiment.decoding: Identical pinned frozen inference backend, BF16 CUDA, greedy 48-token EOS/strict JSON contract; invalid outputs stay incorrect.
experiment.native_input: 695856-byte pinned feature-only sidecar: case/input/token identities and causal prompts. No labels, session dates, dataset paths or fit priors.

interpretation_cautions: Original logged losses are online pre-update completion-token losses on different cases and different training steps. Class aggregates do not measure final class accuracy or identify a causal mechanism.
The save/reload probe was a single NNN example. Equal low probe losses prove persistence, not directional learning.
Seen-example recall is diagnostic, not generalization. An unchanged idle control can achieve high accuracy because no-opportunity dominates.
Class imbalance and limited pilot coverage are hypotheses, not established sole causes. Encoding, labels, optimization budget and feature informativeness also require controlled tests.
6E crossed-quote opportunity labels are auxiliary futures research, not spot/CFD fills, profits or account permission.
summary: Implemented original-fit recall tooling and ran exactly one bounded 384-forecast diagnostic. Native predictions and journals completed, but terminal reporting exceeded the inherited 1 MiB writer limit. Retained and audited complete identity evidence without publishing fit scores because the original native resource/result receipt was not durable. Corrected the writer/reader budget and added durable native-result storage plus production-shaped regression tests. All 36 corrected diagnostic tests and all 4164 workspace tests passed (one optional dependency skip); Ruff is clean. A source-bound corrected registration is ready but has not started. No further GPU run, training or trade was launched.

failed_attempt.root_cause: Inherited advisory_training_run._write accepts only 1048576 UTF-8 bytes. A full 84-session, four-model pooled/per-session report exceeded it, despite the diagnostic protocol allowing 2097152 bytes. Smaller fixture session counts did not exercise this mismatch.
failed_attempt.recovery_policy: No scoring or resource-receipt reconstruction, no edits to failed run/registration, no automatic native retry. Original source retained with matching raw pins. The old registration is historical evidence and deliberately cannot run against changed source.

training_trace.interpretation: Original online PRE-update loss by class; not post-fit loss or fit accuracy. The single reload probe is identified by its original first-example class.

reporting_fix.writer: Exclusive binary UTF-8, size checked before creation, 2097152-byte cap, flush and fsync.
reporting_fix.reader: Pinned existing metadata parser also caps at 2097152 bytes.
reporting_fix.native_receipt: gpu_result.json is saved and fsynced by the native worker before transport. Parent and read-only verifier require exact canonical equality with transported/report evidence.
reporting_fix.validation: Complete 384 forecasts, all 771 journal entries, native receipt, pinned metadata and source, runtime/resources/parameter guards, full pooled and every-session scores; no subset, no retry.
regressions: 84-session report exceeds legacy 1 MiB writer but fits and round-trips at the declared 2 MiB cap
UTF-8 overflow rejected before file creation
Exclusive output cannot overwrite an existing artifact
Persisted native result required for verification
Pure import, exact fit-only membership before target reads, packet drift, offline/runtime/tokenization/resource/frozen guards, journal completeness, no subset or transport retry, post-input drift

next_step.action: One fresh explicitly approved, newly registered comparison after final tests; unchanged original 192 examples and same adapter/decoding, 384 forecasts, 30-minute native cap, no updates/downloads/trading/retries.
next_step.reason: Without a verified fit-recall result, distinguish learning failure from development transfer failure before choosing the next training design.
next_step.candidate_training_not_launched: If seen-fit recall also collapses, predeclare one fresh label-focused/class-coverage training pilot using fit-only selection, then separately assess seen recall and full already-exposed development transfer. Do not tune on reserved outcomes or equate higher activity with edge.

verification_commands.policy: Registration is not launch authority. Never reuse old failure output or mark partial evidence successful; no retry or automatic model promotion.
